usageNotes: Suspends a running LXC container by freezing all its processes; the container remains in memory but is unresponsive until resumed. This feature is marked experimental by Proxmox and may not behave correctly for all workloads — prefer stopping the container for predictable results. The call returns a task UPID string; poll the node task API to confirm completion before assuming the container is suspended.

examples.summary: Suspend LXC container 201 on node pve1

destructiveReason: Suspends all processes in the container, immediately interrupting any active workloads or network services until the container is explicitly resumed.
tips: This endpoint has no body parameters — POST with an empty body or no body.
Use post_nodes_node_lxc_vmid_status_resume to bring the container back online after suspension.
Because suspend is experimental in LXC, test on non-critical containers first; some unprivileged containers or those using certain cgroup features may freeze incorrectly.
The returned UPID can be passed to get_nodes_node_tasks_upid_status to poll task completion.
